name: Startup Vendor MSA
description: Protects a startup signing a SaaS vendor or enterprise supplier Master Services Agreement.

rules.position: Mutual cap at 12 months of fees paid/payable; exclude consequential damages.
rules.fallback: 2x annual fees for confidentiality/data breach super-cap only.

rules.position: No silent auto-renewal, or at most 30 days advance notice with email reminder.
rules.fallback: Annual renewal with 30-day opt-out and max 5% price uplift cap.

rules.position: Customer retains 100% ownership of all data, outputs, and pre-existing IP; no AI training on customer data.
rules.fallback: Aggregated/anonymized telemetry only for service reliability.

rules.position: Indemnification must be mutual (vendor covers IP infringement & data breach; customer covers misuse).
rules.fallback: Cap customer indemnity obligations at the general liability cap.

rules.position: Net 30 from receipt of undisputed invoice; right to dispute in good faith without suspension.
rules.fallback: Net 15 with 15-day cure period before service suspension.

name: Agency Client SOW / MSA
description: Protects agencies and freelancers on scope creep, IP transfer on payment, and payment timing.

rules.position: Deliverable IP transfers to Client only upon receipt of full payment; Agency retains background tools/libraries.
rules.fallback: License to background tools granted on a non-exclusive basis.

rules.position: 50% upfront deposit, Net 15–30 on milestones; work pauses if invoices are >15 days overdue.
Includes 2 rounds of revisions; out-of-scope requests require a written Change Order.
rules.fallback: Billed hourly at standard rate for work beyond written deliverables.

rules.position: Client pays for all completed work + 25% kill fee on remaining committed phase if terminated for convenience.
rules.fallback: 14 days written notice + payment for all work in progress.

name: Mutual NDA (Fast-Track)
description: Standard balanced mutual confidentiality agreement without hidden non-competes or perpetual traps.

rules.position: Confidentiality obligations must be strictly mutual, not one-way.
rules.fallback: None — walk away from one-way NDAs for exploratory talks.

rules.position: 2–3 year confidentiality survival (trade secrets protected while they remain trade secrets).
rules.fallback: Up to 5 years max; reject perpetual confidentiality for general business info.

rules.position: Remove any non-compete, exclusivity, or employee non-solicitation buried in an NDA.
rules.fallback: General job postings explicitly excluded from non-solicit.
